title: curation adjudicate-apply --json (schema 1.0)
description: Applies decisions to the verdicts without calling a model or exporting (design doc 02, section 3.9). The two lists tell the Daemon what to rerun: task_success for relabelled episodes without a human verdict, then the skill profile resync.
